{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Re-load the data to ensure clean state
trial_df = pd.read_csv('data/trial.csv')

# Confirm that the site groups are comparable with respect to severity
# Cross-tabulate site vs severity
crosstab_severity_site = pd.crosstab(trial_df['site'], trial_df['severity'])

# Check if severity distribution differs across sites
severity_by_site = trial_df.groupby('site')['severity'].value_counts(normalize=True)

# Return cross-tab and normalized counts
(crosstab_severity_site, severity_by_site)"}
